$comment: Coverage floors enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs (.github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml). 'measured' is the Jest reading on main 565da3d1 (CI, Node 22: the coverage-gate.yml and auto-qa.yml runs of 2026-10-19 agree; backend: npm run backend:test:coverage, frontend: npm run frontend:test:coverage, both with --coverageReporters=json-summary). 'floor' sits about 3 points below measured so ordinary churn passes but a real drop fails. Floors only go up: .github/workflows/auto-qa.yml proposes raises via a tracking issue (rules in .github/auto-qa-tuning.json). Raising a floor makes the check catch more, so it is the 'Adding or widening a check' case in AGENTS.md's owner's standing decisions: an agent may raise one without asking. Lowering a floor, or exempting anything from it, needs the owner. Scope is whatever each Jest config's collectCoverageFrom selects: backend covers routes, models, middleware and services only (not backend/modules); frontend covers frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx}. Frontend has known failing suites on main (MermaidDiagram, MarkdownRenderer.publicLinks, roleLabels, Layout, markdownTaskList); Jest still writes coverage for the rest, so the number is slightly understated.
